english.toefl: 100 (0–120 scale, accepted through end of 2027) or 5 (new scale)
english.note: PTE 68. English proficiency for non-native speakers may also be met by eligible non-online 2/4-year degrees in U.S., Australia, U.K., Ireland, Anglophone Canada or New Zealand; ECFMG certification; or GRE verbal at/above 50th percentile. TOEFL MyBest accepted.

applicationFee.note: Tufts affiliation, qualifying service/pipeline programs and recruitment-event waivers offered; international eligibility not explicit, confirm. Hardship waivers limited to U.S. citizens, nationals and permanent residents. Request within application, not by email.

documents: Transcripts for completed/in-progress postsecondary degrees: U.S. unofficial copies for review; non-U.S. degrees including Canada require official NACES course-by-course evaluation
Academic statement of purpose (750 words maximum)
Optional More Information essay (250 words maximum)
requirements.note: Original official transcripts required on acceptance. Application-review evaluation instructions include Canada, while enrollment paragraph excludes Canada; follow stricter application-review instruction or confirm with GSBS. Apply to GMCB and select Mammalian Genetics at JAX. Research experience strongly valued but not required. Dissertation research must be at The Jackson Laboratory in Bar Harbor.

funding.note: Tuition scholarship, stipend and health insurance; student activity fee excluded. Rate explicitly 2026–27. Central page notes rare self-funded students and tuition scholarship for first five years; confirm individual award.

timeline.decisions: Rolling admissions beginning as early as January.
